architecture: RC9.2-compatible universal platform with protected lower-tier champion ordering plus target-locked residual OFF/day-balance polish
backward_compatibility: Workbook-driven contract preserved; new controls are optional CLI switches.
key_changes: For 90%-target schedules, 80% protected coverage now ranks before configured lower floor, balance, overage, and 100% upside.
For 100%-target schedules, 90% is protected before the configured 80% floor; 80% remains protected by the configured floor when applicable.
Skeleton-only runs reserve a bounded tail for two-phase target-locked residual polish instead of spending the entire budget on repeated profile basins.
Residual polish Phase P1 hard-locks the best target count and searches protected tiers; Phase P2 hard-locks target plus protected tiers and optimizes floor/gap shape/balance/overage.
Existing RC9.2 candidates are retained, so the residual polish cannot erase a stronger incumbent.
Fixed/nesting constraints remain authoritative and are not weakened.
